Crucial T710 4TB PCIe Gen5 NVMe 2280 M.2 SSD with heatsink | CT4000T710SSD5 | Crucial EU

## Leading Gen5 technology 

Crucial is a pioneer in blazing-fast Gen5 storage, built for maximum performance. The T710 showcases Crucial’s innovation and pushes the boundaries of what’s possible in gaming, creativity, and beyond.

#### Give yourself room to grow 

Expand and thrive with new games, videos, photos and the programs you need to run them. The T710 expands your potential for gaming and creativity, giving you quick access to huge libraries and immersive experiences. 

Available in 1, 2 and 4TB options6

DirectStorage optimized for better game support and performance7

###### Bigger wins 

Feel the power of Gen5 gameplay from the moment you spawn with up to 14,900/13,800 sequential reads/writes. 1 

 

###### Immersive gameplay 

Enter a world with realistic reflections, fog and lighting with advanced ray tracing in applicable games.

 

###### Point. Click. Done. 

The T710 now offers an optional heatsink3 for maximum heat dissipation without fans or liquid cooling.

1. Typical I/O performance as measured using CrystalDiskMark® with a queue depth of 512 and write cache enabled. Windows 11 Core isolation disabled for performance measurement. Fresh out-of-box (FOB) state is assumed. For performance measurement purposes, the SSD may be restored to FOB state using the secure erase command. System variations will affect measured results.
2. See Micron.com/products/nand-flash for more information.
3. Non-heatsink versions of the Crucial T710 must be installed with a motherboard or alternate heatsink to achieve optimal performance.
4. Under typical conditions for airflow and ambient temperature, our pre-installed premium heatsink allows the T710 Gen5 SSD to run at max workload without the need to thermal throttle. Comparisons made to SSD temperatures without a cooling apparatus. Please ensure your drive has proper airflow for maximum performance.
5. The Crucial T710 SSD uses 8.25W compared to 11.25W for the Crucial T705 SSD, resulting in a power savings of 26.6%.
6. Some storage capacity is used for formatting and other purposes and is not available for data storage. 1GB equals 1 billion bytes.
7. Compared to Gen5 SSD performance without DirectStorage, based on internal test results with supported GPU that uses GPU decompression.
8. Warranty valid for 5 years from the original date of purchase or before writing the maximum total bytes written (TBW) as published in the product datasheet and as measured in the product’s SMART data, whichever comes first.

Highlights:
# Crucial T710 SSD support 

 Important update regarding Crucial T710 SSDs

Certain Crucial T710 SSD products were shipped with firmware versions PBCR5101 or PBCR5102. These products were designed to include Self-Encrypting Drive (SED) functionality using AES-256 encryption, following the TCG Opal 2.01 specification. However, the encryption engine may not be properly enabled on some T710 devices with these firmware versions. This potential issue may affect the encryption of data, even if the system indicates otherwise. To address this potential issue, we have released firmware version PBCR5103. 

If your Crucial T710 SSD shipped to you with firmware version PBCR5103, as seen on the product ID label on the SSD, your T710 is not affected by this potential issue, and you may use your SSD as usual. Please note that your SSD is not affected by this potential issue if you have not engaged encryption tools and do not intend to do so in the future. 

### T710 SSD firmware update

Version PBCR5103

RELEASE NOTES:

- Facilitates functioning of the encryption engine. 
- After the firmware update is complete, additional steps are required in order to initiate the encryption engine. Please follow the instructions below. 

.If your Crucial T710 SSD has firmware version PBCR5101 or PBCR5102, updated firmware, PBCR5103 is available through the Crucial Storage Executive software. If you do not already have Crucial Storage Executive installed on your computer, you may download it below.

What you should do

- Ensure that your backups are current and validated on a separate storage device. Backup is always important and will be helpful after you update your firmware to the latest version available.
- If you are already using or are planning to use Microsoft BitLocker in the Windows Pro and Enterprise editions, the functionality of BitLocker encryption is not affected by this issue. BitLocker users may perform the firmware update but do not need to perform the Sanitize operation described below.
- Obtain the firmware update using Crucial Storage Executive. Crucial Storage Executive has full instructions to help you through the update process. After updating the firmware, a full reformat/sanitize of the Crucial T710 SSD must be performed to fully initialize the encryption engine. This will erase all user data. This one-time action will be necessary to properly engage the encryption engine after updating the firmware.
- You can update firmware without Sanitizing your SSD, if you are not using encryption, or if you are using Microsoft BitLocker. In this case, the following steps to Sanitize your SSD are not necessary.
- The following steps will delete all data on your Crucial T710 SSD, so you should ensure that your data is backed up before proceeding. You should be prepared to recover data from backup or to reinstall your Operating System.
- If your Crucial T710 SSD is configured as a secondary drive, after the firmware update is applied, you may use the Crucial Storage Executive software to reset the drive, using the SANITIZE function.
- If your Crucial T710 SSD is configured as your operating system drive, you can use the SSD Sanitize function included in your computer system’s BIOS. If this function is not available, then please contact Crucial Support, and we will help you with this process.
- Request a warranty return. You may contact Support at Crucial.com to request a warranty return and replacement with a new Crucial T710 SSD that will have the updated firmware.

---

## Tecnologia líder de 5.ª geração 

A Crucial é pioneira no armazenamento ultrarrápido de 5.ª geração, desenvolvido para o máximo desempenho. A T710 apresenta a inovação da Crucial e ultrapassa os limites do que é possível nos games, para os profissionais de criação e em diversos aspectos.

#### Abra espaço para seu crescimento 

Disponível nas opções de 1, 2 e 4 TB6

DirectStorage otimizado para melhor suporte e desempenho do jogo7

Feel the power of Gen5 gameplay from the moment you spawn with up to 14,900/13,800 sequential reads/writes. 1 

1. Desempenho típico de E/S medidos usando o CrystalDiskMark® com uma profundidade de fila de 512 e cache de gravação ativado. Isolamento do Windows 11 Core desativado para medição de desempenho. Presume-se o estado novo fora da caixa (Fresh out-of-box, FOB). Para fins de medição de desempenho, a SSD pode ser restaurada para o estado FOB usando o comando secure erase. As variações do sistema afetarão os resultados medidos.
2. Consulte Micron.com/products/nand-flash para mais informações.
3. As versões sem difusor de calor da Crucial T710 devem ser instaladas com uma placa-mãe ou dissipador de calor alternativo para alcançar o desempenho ideal.
4. Sob condições típicas de fluxo de ar e temperatura ambiente, nosso dissipador de calor premium pré-instalado permite que a SSD T710 de 5.ª geração funcione com carga de trabalho máxima sem a necessidade de aceleração térmica. Comparações feitas com temperaturas SSD sem um aparelho de resfriamento. Verifique se a sua unidade possui fluxo de ar adequado para o máximo desempenho.
5. A SSD Crucial T710 usa 8,25 W em comparação com 11,25 W da SSD Crucial T705, resultando em uma economia de energia de 26,6%.
6. Parte da capacidade de armazenamento é usada para formatação e outras finalidades e não está disponível para o armazenamento de dados. 1 GB equivale a 1 bilhão de bytes.
7. Comparado ao desempenho da SSD de 5.ª geração sem DirectStorage, baseado em resultados de testes internos com GPU compatível que usa descompressão de GPU.
8. Garantia válida por cinco anos a partir da data original da compra ou antes de gravar o total máximo de bytes gravados (Total Bytes Written, TBW), conforme publicado na ficha técnica do produto e conforme medido nos dados SMART do produto, o que ocorrer primeiro.
